name: arabic-tashkeel
description: Add 'tashkeel' or diacritical marks to Arabic text.

scripts.copy: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -R images dist/images && cp -R model dist/model
scripts.build: parcel build content.js background.js --dist-dir dist && npm run copy
scripts.build-dev: NODE_ENV=development parcel build content.js background.js --dist-dir dist && npm run copy

author: Gilad Amar
